Insert a Column chart on Slide 2 with the following FY2024 quarterly revenue data:
- Q1 2024: 2.4
- Q2 2024: 3.1
- Q3 2024: 2.8

(Values are in millions USD). After entering the data and configuring the chart as a Column (vertical bar) chart, click outside the chart to finish editing, then save the file with Ctrl+S.
